mentions.name: ShopSpec
mentions.description: A parametric, deterministic furniture builder for designing furniture pieces, with a gallery of actual builds; the tool is actively being iterated on based on the builder's personal use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on ShopSpec, a parametric deterministic furniture builder. Trying to find time to put more actual builds in the gallery - have a few projects that are in progress while continuing to build out the tool and iterate where I find personally useful.
mentions.author: variodot
